scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['dist','coverage']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p,{ recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.verify:fast: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run verify:fast && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.rust:test:math: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev cargo test -p drift-math
scripts.rust:test:data: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev cargo test -p drift-data
scripts.rust:test:sim: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev cargo test -p drift-sim
scripts.rust:clippy: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev cargo clippy --workspace
scripts.rust:fmt: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev cargo fmt --all
scripts.rust:fmt:check: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev cargo fmt --all -- --check
scripts.rust:shell: docker compose -f rust-backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm rust-dev bash
